title: Flow Cytometry Analysis of Mouse Keratinocytes and Skin Immune Cells
author: Sakamoto, Goel, et al.

steps.title: Prepare antibody panels and master mixes
steps.instruction:
Prepare the flow‑cytometry antibody panels for keratinocyte (epidermis and whole skin), innate lymphoid cell (ILC), and myeloid cell analyses as listed in Tables 1‑4. This preparation takes approximately 0.5–1 h. For each panel, create an antibody master mix immediately before staining using the final dilutions indicated (all antibodies diluted in 5 % FACS buffer):
- **Keratinocyte panel (epidermis, Table 1)**: BV421‑CD34 (RAM34) 1/100; BV711‑MHC II (M5/1) 1/140; APC‑Cy7‑Sca‑1 (D7) 1/200; BUV395‑CD45 (30‑F11) 1/200; PE‑CD200 (OX‑90) 1/100; PE‑Cy7‑EpCAM (G8.8) 1/200.
- **Keratinocyte panel (whole skin, Table 2)**: same antibodies and dilutions as Table 1 plus APC‑CD31 (MEC13.3) 1/200.
- **ILC panel (Table 3)**: PerCP‑Cy5.5‑CD3ε (145‑2C1) 1/200; PerCP‑Cy5.5‑CD55 (3‑7) 1/200; PerCP‑Cy5.5‑CD196 (D5‑1) 1/200; PerCP‑Cy5.5‑CD11b (M1/70) 1/200; PerCP‑Cy5.5‑CD11c (N418) 1/200; PerCP‑Cy5.5‑FcεRIα (MAR‑11) 1/200; PerCP‑Cy5.5‑NK1.1 (PK136) 1/200; PerCP‑Cy5.5‑CD2 (RM2‑5) 1/200; BV421‑CD45 (30‑F11) 1/100; BV711‑MHC II (M5/1) 1/3000; APC‑Cy7‑Sca‑1 (D7) 1/200; BUV395‑Thy1.2 (3‑2.11) 1/200; PE‑Cy7‑CCR6 (2‑L17) 1/200.
- **Myeloid panel (Table 4)**: PerCP‑Cy5.5‑CD3ε (145‑2C1) 1/300; PerCP‑Cy5.5‑CD196 (D5‑1) 1/300; PerCP‑Cy5.5‑NK1.1 (PK136) 1/300; PerCP‑Cy5.5‑Siglec‑F (E50‑244) 1/401; BV421‑CD11b (30‑F11) 1/400; BV650‑CD11c (N418) 1/200; BV711‑Ly6c (HK1.4) 1/400; APC‑Cy7‑EpCAM (G8.8) 1/200; BUV395‑CD45 (30‑F11) 1/200; PE‑CCR2 (47530) 1/200; PE‑CF594‑CD64 (X54‑5/7) 1/200; PE‑Cy7‑MHC II (M5/1) 1/5000.
- **Transcription‑factor antibodies (Table 5)**: AF647‑GATA3 (L50‑823) 1/20; PE‑RORγt (Q31‑378) 1/50.
All antibodies are diluted in 5 % FACS buffer unless otherwise noted.

steps.title: Aliquot cells and perform initial washes
steps.instruction: Transfer 150 µL of cell suspension into each well of a 96‑well V‑bottom plate. Centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4 °C. Resuspend the pellet in 200 µL PBS, centrifuge again at 400 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Stain viability with Zombie Aqua
steps.instruction: Dilute Zombie Aqua Fixable Viability Kit (BioLegend) 1:200 in PBS. Add 100 µL of this solution to each well, mix, and incubate at room temperature (15 °C–25 °C) for 15 min protected from light (cover with aluminum foil).

steps.title: Block Fc receptors
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant. Dilute anti‑mouse CD16/32 (Fc block) 1:200 in 5 % FACS buffer. Add 100 µL of Fc‑block solution to each sample and incubate on ice for 5 min.

steps.title: Surface antibody staining
steps.instruction: While the Fc block is incubating, prepare the surface‑antibody master mix (Table 1) in Eppendorf tubes or 15 mL conical tubes according to the total volume required. After the 5‑min Fc‑block incubation, centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, add 100 µL of the antibody master mix to each well, and incubate on ice, protected from light, for 25 min. (For the ILC panel, omit anti‑GATA3 and anti‑RORγt antibodies at this stage; they will be added later.)

steps.title: Wash stained cells
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of 5 % FACS buffer to each well, centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, and discard the supernatant. Repeat the wash once more. Finally, resuspend the cells in 200 µL of 5 % FACS buffer and keep on ice until further processing.

steps.title: Optional fixation for keratinocyte/myeloid panels
steps.instruction: If immediate data collection is not possible, fix the cells: add 200 µL FluoroFix™ Buffer, incubate at room temperature in the dark for 30 min, centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend in 200 µL 5 % FACS buffer, centrifuge again at 400 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, repeat the resuspension step, and keep cells on ice until acquisition.

steps.title: Fix and permeabilize for transcription factor staining
steps.instruction: For ILC transcription‑factor detection, add 200 µL of 1× Foxp3 Fixation/Permeabilization solution (eBioscience™ Foxp3/Transcription Factor Staining Buffer Set) to each sample and incubate at room temperature in the dark for 30 min. Centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, resuspend in 200 µL of 1× Permeabilization Buffer, centrifuge again at 400 × g for 3 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant. Prepare 1× Permeabilization Buffer containing 2 % normal rat serum (100 µL per sample), resuspend cells in 100 µL of this buffer, and incubate at room temperature in the dark for 15 min.

steps.title: Intracellular antibody staining (overnight)
steps.instruction: Prepare a master mix of anti‑GATA3 (AF647, clone L50‑823, 1/20) and anti‑RORγt (PE, clone Q31‑378, 1/50) in 1× Permeabilization Buffer with 2 % normal rat serum at the final dilutions listed in Table 5. Add the mix to each sample and incubate at 4 °C in the dark overnight (approximately 12 h).

steps.title: Final washes and resuspend for acquisition
steps.instruction: After the overnight incubation, centrifuge at 400 × g for 3 min at 4 °C and discard supernatant. Wash twice with 200 µL of 1× Permeabilization Buffer (centrifuge each wash at 400 × g for 3 min at 4 °C and discard supernatant). Resuspend the cells in 200 µL of 1× Permeabilization Buffer and keep on ice until data collection.
